description: Proportion of Hazardous Waste Treated, by Type of Treatment is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Ministry of Environment and Climate Change. This dataset provides key metrics on electronic waste management, including the amount of electronic waste generated, collected, and recycled, along with per capita data for recycling and collection. The data spans from 2016 to 2023 and supports insights on recycling rates and waste management efficiency. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Environment and Climate Change. Its tags are waste, recycling, Collection, Per Capita, tonnes. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-01-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
